 AFCON Qualifiers Group F, Matchday 4 
 Central African Republic 0 – 1 Benin Oloko 90+3' FULL TIME Central African Republic 0-1 Benin, Ede Oloko strikes in stoppage time
 Central African Republic and Benin finished 0-1 in AFCON Qualifiers. Relive the goals, highlights, match stats and full summary on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 16, 2026, 1:00 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 1:00 PM ET 12:59 PM ET 36 minutes ago Full-time: Final whistle in Cameroon!
 The final whistle sounds at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma as Benin secure a 1-0 victory over Central African Republic. Central African Republic held 53% possession and earned five corners to two, while Benin registered 10 total shots to seven and committed 23 fouls against 20. Thank you for following this Benin win on VAVEL!
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Key moments
 12:59 PM ET Full-time: Final whistle in Cameroon! 
 12:56 PM ET 90+3' Goal by Ede Oloko · 0-1 
 12:52 PM ET 88' Yellow card · Junior Olaitan 
 12:52 PM ET 88' Yellow card · Geoffrey Kondogbia 
 12:50 PM ET 86' Yellow card · Mohamed Tijani 
 11:56 AM ET Tactical takeaways & benches for the second half 
 11:52 AM ET Half-time in Douala 
 11:48 AM ET 44' Yellow card · Yawanendji-Malipangou 
 11:38 AM ET 36' Yellow card · Julien Kouadio 
 11:09 AM ET 5' Yellow card · Aiyegun Tosin 
 11:00 AM ET 1' Kickoff! Central African Republic vs Benin… 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 90+3' 12:56 PM ET 39 minutes ago GOAL! Ede Oloko scores for Benin
 GOAL FOR BENIN! Ede Oloko finds the back of the net at 90'.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 90+2' 12:56 PM ET 39 minutes ago Benin bring on Ahlinvi
 Benin turn to Mattéo Ahlinvi in the 90+2' minute, replacing Junior Olaitan during stoppage time. The visitors have outshot Central African Republic 10-7 with two attempts on target, in a physical closing stretch featuring 20 fouls from the hosts and 21 from Benin.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 89' 12:52 PM ET 43 minutes ago Double change for Benin
 Benin make a double substitution in the 89th minute as Dokou Dodo and Ede Oloko come on for Aiyegun Tosin and Imourane Hassane. The fresh legs arrive late in Cameroon with Central African Republic and Benin locked at just one shot on target apiece.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 88' 12:52 PM ET 43 minutes ago Junior Olaitan booked
 Junior Olaitan is shown a yellow card for Benin in the 88th minute at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma. The booking brings the foul count level at 19 apiece between Benin and Central African Republic, while the visitors hold a 9-5 edge in total shots with just one effort on target for each side.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 88' 12:52 PM ET 43 minutes ago Yellow card shown to Geoffrey Kondogbia
 Geoffrey Kondogbia goes into the referee's book for Central African Republic with a yellow card in the 88th minute.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 86' 12:50 PM ET an hour ago Yellow card shown to Mohamed Tijani
 Mohamed Tijani goes into the referee's book for Benin with a yellow card in the 86th minute.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 86' 12:48 PM ET an hour ago Deadlock holds in Douala
 Central African Republic have edged ahead in possession at 51% to Benin's 49% as the clock hits the 86th minute at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma. Despite the hosts holding a 5-2 advantage in corner kicks, Benin still lead the overall shot count 9-4 while both sides remain level at one effort on target apiece.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 79' 12:41 PM ET an hour ago Junior Olugbade enters for Benin
 Benin make an adjustment at minute 79, sending on Junior Olugbade while Yamirou Ouorou makes way.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 77' 12:39 PM ET an hour ago Midfield fouls & physical duels
 Physical edge in midfield approaching minute 77 (Central African Republic 0-0 Benin). The referee has called 35 fouls overall - 18 against Central African Republic and 17 on Benin.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 72' 12:34 PM ET an hour ago Chances traded between Central African Republic and Benin
 Benin have generated the sharper attacking volume so far (3-8 in total shots, 1-1 on target), with the match at Central African Republic 0-0 Benin. The goalkeepers have combined for 2 saves (1-1) so far.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 64' 12:26 PM ET an hour ago Hosts press from the corner flag
 Approaching the 64th minute at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma, Central African Republic lead 4-1 in corner kicks over Benin. Stoppages have been frequent in Cameroon, with 13 fouls whistled against the hosts and 16 on the visitors. Benin hold a 7-2 advantage in total shots, though only one attempt has tested the goalkeeper on target.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 57' 12:19 PM ET an hour ago Fresh legs for Central African Republic
 The board goes up on the touchline in the 57th minute: Isaac Solet joins the action for Central African Republic , replacing Moustapha Djimet .
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 54' 12:15 PM ET an hour ago Possession & midfield tempo
 Central African Republic 0-0 Benin at the 54-minute mark. Central African Republic have controlled 47% of possession against Benin's 53%, with the shot count at 2-6 (0-1 on target).
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 46' 12:08 PM ET an hour ago Mafouta comes on for the hosts
 Central African Republic make a change in the 46th minute as Louis Mafouta enters the match in place of Christian-Theodor Yawanendji-Malipangou. The hosts bring on fresh legs in Douala after Benin edged ahead 52% to 48% in possession and reached five total shots, with one on target.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 46' 12:07 PM ET an hour ago Second half underway!
 The ball is rolling again for the second half! Central African Republic 0-0 Benin with 45 minutes left to play.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:56 AM ET 2 hours ago Tactical takeaways & benches for the second half
 Beyond the 0-0 scoreline, midfield control has hinged on passing accuracy, with Central African Republic completing 74% of 145 passes against 79% of 152 for Benin. On the benches, options like Alladum Kolimba / Flory Yangao and Liam Omore / Mattéo Ahlinvi are ready if either coach moves early after the restart.
 Completed passes (accuracy): Central African Republic 145 (74%) – 152 (79%) Benin
 Duels won: Central African Republic 23 – 24 Benin
 Dangerous attacks: Central African Republic 22 – 27 Benin
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:52 AM ET 2 hours ago Half-time in Douala
 The half-time whistle sounds at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma with Central African Republic and Benin level at 0-0. Benin hold 51% possession to 49% for the hosts and lead 4-2 in shots, with one effort on target. Central African Republic earned both corners of a physical first half that saw 11 fouls by the hosts and 12 from Benin.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 44' 11:48 AM ET 2 hours ago Yellow card for Yawanendji-Malipangou
 Christian-Theodor Yawanendji-Malipangou is cautioned in the 44th minute, earning Central African Republic another booking at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma. That foul pulls Central African Republic level with Benin at 11 infractions apiece late in the first half. With halftime approaching, Central African Republic edge possession at 51% to 49%, though Benin still lead 4-1 in total shots.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 42' 11:44 AM ET 2 hours ago First shot for Central African Republic
 Central African Republic register their first shot in the 42nd minute in Douala, while Benin move up to four attempts. Benin own the match's lone shot on target despite holding 48% of the ball against the hosts' 52%, with corners favoring Central African Republic 2-0. Fouls are now level at 10 apiece at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma with halftime approaching.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 36' 11:38 AM ET 2 hours ago Booking for Julien Kouadio
 Julien Kouadio is shown a yellow card for Central African Republic in minute 36 at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma. That foul puts Central African Republic at 9 infractions compared to 10 by Benin. Despite 53% possession and 2 corners, the hosts still have 0 shots while Benin has 4 attempts with 1 on target.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 32' 11:34 AM ET 2 hours ago Midfield rhythm on the pitch
 Still 0-0 between Central African Republic and Benin through 32 minutes. Possession is 53%-47% with shots at 0-2.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 25' 11:27 AM ET 2 hours ago Whistle busy in the middle third
 Physical edge in midfield approaching minute 25 (Central African Republic 0-0 Benin). The referee has called 12 fouls overall - 5 against Central African Republic and 7 on Benin.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 19' 11:21 AM ET 2 hours ago Benin threaten despite trailing in possession
 Central African Republic holds 59% of the ball through 19 minutes at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma, yet Benin has produced the only two shots of the match so far. One of those Benin attempts forced the Central African Republic goalkeeper into a save, while the hosts have committed three fouls compared to five by the visitors.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 14' 11:16 AM ET 2 hours ago Wing progression testing both back lines
 Play continues at 0-0 approaching minute 14. Corner kicks read 1 for Central African Republic and 0 for Benin, alongside a 0-2 tally in total attempts. Full live match metrics are tracking on GioScore .
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 5' 11:09 AM ET 2 hours ago Yellow card for Aiyegun Tosin
 Aiyegun Tosin picks up the first booking of the match for Benin in the 5th minute at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma. That marks Benin's second foul compared to one by Central African Republic, though Benin still edges possession at 54% and has the lone shot recorded so far.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 5' 11:08 AM ET 2 hours ago Benin shades early possession
 Benin has seen 57% of the ball through the opening 5 minutes against Central African Republic at Stade Omnisport de Douala Japoma. Neither side has managed a shot or a corner yet, with Central African Republic holding 43% of the possession in Cameroon. Play has been choppy early on, with Benin committing 2 fouls to Central African Republic's 1 in the midfield.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1' 11:00 AM ET 3 hours ago Kickoff! Central African Republic vs Benin is underway
 We are underway! Central African Republic and Benin kick off the first half. Follow every goal, chance, and live tactical update right here on VAVEL.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:54 AM ET 3 hours ago Players in the tunnel ahead of kick-off: Central African Republic vs Benin
 The starting XIs for Central African Republic and Benin are lined up in the tunnel at Stade Omnisport de Douala and ready to walk out onto the pitch for kick-off.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:45 AM ET 3 hours ago 15 minutes to kick-off for Central African Republic vs Benin
 On-pitch drills have concluded at Stade Omnisport de Douala as Central African Republic and Benin return to the dressing rooms ahead of kick-off in AFCON Qualifiers . Match referee: CAF match referee .
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:38 AM ET 3 hours ago Squads out on the pitch for Central African Republic vs Benin
 Players from Central African Republic and Benin are out on the pitch at Stade Omnisport de Douala completing their pre-match drills 20 minutes before kick-off.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:30 AM ET 3 hours ago 30 minutes to kick-off: Central African Republic vs Benin
 We are 30 minutes away from kick-off between Central African Republic and Benin at Stade Omnisport de Douala in AFCON Qualifiers . Match referee: CAF match referee .
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:14 AM ET 3 hours ago Confirmed Central African Republic Starting XI
 Central African Republic starting lineup: #16 Dominique Youfeigane, #23 Hugo Gambor, #5 Emmanuel Okeke, #2 Julien Kouadio, #14 Séverin Tatolna, #6 B. Diomande, #18 Christian-Theodor Yawanendji-Malipangou, #15 Edwin Quarshie, #19 Geoffrey Kondogbia, #10 Goduine Koyalipou, #11 Moustapha Djimet. Substitutes: Alladum Kolimba, Flory Yangao, Noah Ato-Zandanga, Isaac Solet, Louis Mafouta, Sami Wattel, Joel Ngoya, Junior Sambia, Delphin Mokonou.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:14 AM ET 3 hours ago Confirmed Benin Starting XI
 Benin starting lineup: #1 Marcel Dandjinou, #12 Charlemagne Azongnitode, #2 Mohamed Tijani, #3 Tamimou Ouorou, #5 Yohan Roche, #8 Imourane Hassane, #18 Junior Olaitan, #15 Sessi D'Almeida, #10 Aiyegun Tosin, #17 Rodolfo Aloko, #13 Yamirou Ouorou.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:14 AM ET 3 hours ago Nothing separating Cent Afr Rep and Benin
 Play continues in live play inside Stade Omnisport de Douala as Central African Republic and Benin contest every possession. Goduine Koyalipou (Central African Republic: 2) and Tosin Aiyegun (Benin: 2) lead the statistical categories so far.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:14 AM ET 3 hours ago Final field check ahead of Cent Afr Rep vs Benin
 Players are on site at Stade Omnisport de Douala as Central African Republic and Benin get ready for action in AFCON Qualifiers .
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:10 AM ET 3 hours ago 35 minutes to kickoff in Japoma: Central African Republic and Benin near walkouts
 We are 35 minutes from kickoff between Central African Republic and Benin at Stade Omnisport de Douala (11:00 a.m. ET / 16:00 UTC). Official starting XIs, national anthems and live AFCON Qualifiers updates follow next on VAVEL USA.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:48 AM ET 4 hours ago Neutral Cameroon setting at 50,000-capacity Stade Omnisport de Douala
 Warm 30-degree Celsius afternoon conditions greet Central African Republic and Benin at Japoma's 50,000-seat Stade Omnisport de Douala ahead of the 11:00 a.m. ET (16:00 UTC) whistle.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:26 AM ET 4 hours ago Goalkeeper numbers: Dominique Youfeigane (10 saves) vs Marcel Dandjinou (7 saves)
 Central African Republic keeper Dominique Youfeigane enters today's game with 10 Group F saves, while Benin number one Marcel Dandjinou owns 7 saves across an unbeaten 2-1-0 start.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:04 AM ET 5 hours ago 98 accurate passes apiece for defenders Hugo Gambor and Yohan Roche
 Central African Republic center-back Hugo Gambor and Benin defender Yohan Roche stand tied on 98 completed passes apiece across three Group F games, pacing back-line distribution for their nations.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:43 AM ET 5 hours ago Tosin Aiyegun and Rodolfo Aloko share Group F lead with 3 goals apiece
 Benin forwards Tosin Aiyegun (3 goals, 10 shots) and Rodolfo Aloko (3 goals in 3 starts) have combined for 6 of the Cheetahs' 7 Group F goals entering Matchday 4 in Douala.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:21 AM ET 5 hours ago Five-goal flashback: Benin defeated Central African Republic 4-1 on November 12
 Four days ago in Abidjan, Hassane Imourane (7'), Rodolfo Aloko (31') and Tosin Aiyegun (36', 56') fired Benin past Central African Republic 4-1, canceling out Louis Mafouta's 19th-minute equalizer.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
